name: @activepieces/piece-asknews
description: AskNews piece allows you to search and retrieve enriched real-time and historical news articles using AskNews API.

auth.description:
To obtain your AskNews API key:

1. Visit [AskNews](https://asknews.app)
2. Sign up or log in to your account
3. Click on your profile and navigate to 'Settings' > 'API Credentials'
4. Generate a new API key
5. Copy and paste the key here

searchNews.name: searchNews
searchNews.description: Search for enriched real-time news articles from the past 48 hours or historical archive

query.description: Search query - can be a phrase, keyword, question, or paragraph. Leave empty to search by filters only.

method.description: Search method to use. "kw" for keyword matching, "nl" for semantic/natural language search, "both" for hybrid

returnType.description: Format of returned articles. "string" is prompt-optimized, "dicts" is structured data, "both" returns both

historical.description: Search in historical archive (60+ days back) instead of just recent news (48 hours)

hoursBack.description: Number of hours back to search from current time. Defaults to 24.

similarityScoreThreshold.description: Minimum similarity score (0-1) for results. Lower = more lenient matches.

aiMetadata.description: Searches enriched news articles via the AskNews API, defaulting to recent coverage but able to query the historical archive (60+ days) instead when historical is set. The query can be keywords, a question, or a paragraph, and the search method switches between keyword, semantic natural-language, or hybrid matching; filter by category and recency. Choose this to find or retrieve current/past news on a topic. Read-only and idempotent.

generateNewsKnowledgeGraph.name: generateNewsKnowledgeGraph
generateNewsKnowledgeGraph.description: Build a custom mega-news-knowledge graph with fully disambiguated entities and relationships

query.description: Natural language query for building the graph

nArticles.description: Number of articles to use for building the graph

historical.description: Search historical archive instead of recent news

hoursBack.description: Number of hours back to search

visualizeWith.description: Request a visualization format (e.g., mermaid, svg)

aiMetadata.description: Builds a news knowledge graph of disambiguated entities and their relationships from articles matching a natural-language query, via the AskNews API. Choose this when an agent needs structured entity/relationship extraction (optionally a visualization like mermaid/svg) rather than raw article text. Computes a fresh graph on each call from current matching news; safe to repeat.

getArticleById.name: getArticleById
getArticleById.description: Retrieve a single article or multiple articles by their UUID(s)

articleIds.description: One or more article UUIDs to fetch.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches one or more news articles by their AskNews UUID(s). Choose this when you already hold article UUIDs (e.g. from a prior search) and need their full enriched records. Requires at least one valid UUID. Read-only lookup and idempotent.

asknewsChatCompletion.name: asknewsChatCompletion
asknewsChatCompletion.description: Get chat completions from a news-infused AI assistant powered by OpenAI API

userMessage.description: The user message to send to the chat model

model.description: The model to use for chat completion

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in response

journalistMode.description: Activate AP styling, citations, and fair reporting prompting

inlineCitations.description: How to format citations in results

appendReferences.description: Append full references at the end

conversationalAwareness.description: Enable context awareness for conversational flow

systemPrompt.description: Optional custom system prompt for the model
systemPrompt.defaultValue: You are a helpful AI assistant with access to real-time news and current information.

aiMetadata.description: Sends a user message (with an optional system prompt) to AskNews’ chat-completion endpoint, returning an LLM answer grounded in real-time news with optional inline citations and references. Choose this for natural-language Q&A about current events rather than retrieving raw articles. Generative and non-deterministic, so repeated calls may return different text.

searchStories.name: searchStories
searchStories.description: Filter and search for top news narratives and story clusters

query.description: Natural language or keyword query for search

method.description: nl: semantic search, kw: keyword search, both: combined

aiMetadata.description: Searches AskNews for top news narratives and story clusters (grouped multi-article events) rather than individual articles. The query is optional: with no query it returns top trending stories filtered by category/sort, and with a query it filters to matching narratives via keyword, semantic, or hybrid matching. Choose this for the big-picture narrative view over a topic. Read-only and idempotent.

createANewsletter.name: createANewsletter
createANewsletter.description: Create an automated newsletter powered by news and AI

query.description: Natural language query to define newsletter content

cron.description: Cron expression for newsletter schedule (e.g., "0 0 * * *" for daily at midnight UTC)

model.description: AI model to use for newsletter generation

sender.description: Email address of the newsletter sender

subject.description: Newsletter email subject (auto-generated if not provided)

replyTo.description: Email address for replies (defaults to sender if not provided)

audienceId.description: Existing audience ID (creates new audience if not provided)

resendApiKey.description: API key for Resend email service (required to send newsletter)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new automated AskNews newsletter that recurrently generates and emails AI-written news digests on a cron schedule, defined by a natural-language query. Choose this to set up a recurring news email; requires a name, query, cron expression, model, and sender, plus a Resend API key to actually send. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate newsletter.

newsletterId.description: UUID of the newsletter to update

query.description: Natural language query to define newsletter content

cron.description: Cron expression for newsletter schedule (e.g., "0 0 * * *" for daily at midnight UTC)

model.description: AI model to use for newsletter generation

sender.description: Email address of the newsletter sender

resendApiKey.description: API key for Resend email service

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing AskNews newsletter identified by its UUID, applying only the fields you supply (query, schedule, model, sender, active/public flags, etc.) and leaving the rest unchanged. Choose this to edit or activate/deactivate a newsletter you already created. Requires the newsletter UUID. Repeating the same update yields the same end state.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

alertForQuery.name: alertForQuery
alertForQuery.description: Trigger when a new alert is created for a specific news query

query.description: Query to monitor (e.g., "I want to be alerted if there is a protest in paris")

cron.description: Cron schedule for alert checks (5-7 fields, e.g., "0 * * * *" for every hour, or "0 0 * * * America/New_York")

model.description: AI model to use for alert checking

alwaysTrigger.description: Skip alert check and trigger immediately on schedule

repeat.description: Repeat alert after each trigger (disable for one-time alert)

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an AskNews alert matches a monitored natural-language news query on its cron schedule (or on every scheduled check if "Always Trigger" is enabled), delivering the matching alert payload. Represents a newly detected news development matching the query of interest.
